title: Learning Human-Like Badminton Skills for Humanoid Robots
abstract: arXiv:2602.08370v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Realizing versatile and human-like performance in high-demand sports like badminton remains a formidable challenge for humanoid robotics. Unlike standard locomotion or static manipulation, this task demands a seamless integration of explosive whole-body coordination and precise, timing-critical interception. While recent advances have achieved lifelike motion mimicry, bridging the gap between kinematic imitation and functional, physics-aware striking without compromising stylistic naturalness is non-trivial. To address this, we propose Imitation-to-Interaction, a progressive reinforcement learning framework designed to evolve a robot from a "mimic" to a capable "striker." Our approach establishes a robust motor prior from human data, distills it into a compact, model-based state representation, and stabilizes dynamics via adversarial priors. translated_title: 面向人形机器人的类人羽毛球技能学习
translated_abstract: 在羽毛球等高要求运动中实现多功能且类人的表现，对人形机器人而言仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。与标准运动或静态操作不同，这项任务要求将爆发性的全身协调与精确且时间关键的拦截无缝结合。尽管最近的进展已经实现了逼真的动作模仿，但在不损害动作风格自然性的前提下，弥合运动学模仿与功能性、物理感知击球之间的差距并非易事。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Imitation-to-Interaction（从模仿到交互），这是一个渐进式强化学习框架，旨在使机器人从“模仿者”进化为有能力的“击球手”。我们的方法从人类数据中建立鲁棒的运动先验，将其提炼为紧凑的基于模型的状态表示，并通过对抗先验来稳定动力学。至关重要的是，为了克服专家示范数据的稀疏性，我们引入了一个流形
tldr: 本文提出“从模仿到交互”的渐进式强化学习框架，通过人类运动先验、紧凑的基于模型的状态表示和对抗先验，使仿人机器人从单纯模仿人类动作进化为能够完成功能性、物理感知的羽毛球击球。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a progressive reinforcement learning framework called "Imitation-to-Interaction" that evolves humanoid robots from motion mimics into capable badminton strikers by leveraging robust human motor priors, compact model-based state representations, and adversarial priors to achieve functional, physics-aware striking.
